ndbe01.title: They turn every walk into a race.
ndbe01.caption:
Your date turns a winter stroll into a sprint. Dealbreaker or not?
Not even close. Race to the corner, then slow down together.

ndbe02.title: Your date is rude to the server.
ndbe02.caption:
Your date snaps at the server. Cute dinner, or a warning?
How someone treats the person bringing the food tells you a lot.

ndbe03.title: They talk through the whole movie.
ndbe03.caption:
They narrate every scene of the movie. Annoying or adorable?
Pause it, swap theories, then press play. That counts as a date.

ndbe04.title: They kept the receipt from date one.
ndbe04.caption:
They saved the receipt from your very first date. Too much?
Keeping little things means they were paying attention.

ndbe05.title: They photograph every dessert.
ndbe05.caption:
The cake is getting a full photo shoot before anyone eats. Dealbreaker?
Let the dessert have its moment. Then they share the first bite.

ndbe06.title: They laughed when you said no.
ndbe06.caption:
You said no and they laughed it off. Is that a red line?
Yes. A no is a whole answer, and the right person hears it the first time.

ndbe07.title: They can't pick a restaurant.
ndbe07.caption:
Twenty minutes later, still no restaurant. Dealbreaker or not?
Offer two choices. Indecisive hearts love a short menu.

ndbe08.title: They lied about something small.
ndbe08.caption:
They told a tiny fib about a plant. Does small even matter?
It does. Little lies make it hard to trust the big things.

ndbe09.title: They wrap gifts terribly.
ndbe09.caption:
Their gift wrap looks like a snowball made of tape. Problem?
Never. Lumpy paper, perfect thought inside.

ndbe10.title: They go to bed at 9:30.
ndbe10.caption:
They're asleep by 9:30 every night. Dealbreaker for a night owl?
Not at all. Early sleepers make the best breakfast dates.

ndbe11.title: They read your phone over your shoulder.
ndbe11.caption:
They read your messages over your shoulder. Harmless, or not okay?
Not okay. Trust doesn't peek, and you're allowed your privacy.

ndbe12.title: They cried at the trailer.
ndbe12.caption:
They cried at a movie trailer. Like, a lot. Too soft?
Soft hearts are strong hearts. Bring tissues and keep them close.
